title: Renewal with Low Adoption - Value Not Realized

customer_profile.name: Maya Singh
customer_profile.opening_message: Teams haven’t used it much. I’m not convinced we should renew.
customer_profile.secret_condition: Customer accepts if agent diagnoses adoption blockers and proposes a measurable 30-day success plan with owners, cadence, and a scheduled review
customer_profile.personality_notes: Wants practical improvement fast; will not renew without a clear plan that drives adoption and measurable value.

checkpoints.description: Acknowledge concern and confirm renewal timeline + stakeholders
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Ask when renewal is due and who is involved in the decision.

checkpoints.description: Diagnose adoption blockers (workflow fit, training, champions, integrations, permissions)
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Ask why teams didn’t adopt and what got in the way.

checkpoints.description: Align on 1-2 outcomes and choose one priority workflow to focus on first
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Narrow scope to a high-impact workflow that can improve quickly.

checkpoints.description: Propose a 30-day success plan with owners and weekly cadence
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Include enablement actions, champions, and weekly checkpoints.

checkpoints.description: Define measurement (baseline vs target) and schedule the next review meeting
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Agree on metrics and set a calendar date for review.

scenario_context: Renewal at risk due to low adoption. Must diagnose blockers without blame, align on outcomes, propose a 30-day plan with owners/cadence, and define measurement with a scheduled review. Avoid defensiveness and discount-only tactics.
success_summary: Successfully demonstrate: Renewal Management + Value Realization
